# Planet One Explorer

> Planet One is a high-throughput, carbon-negative Layer-1 blockchain engineered for environmental real-world asset tokenization (eRWA), certified carbon credit lifecycles, regenerative agriculture, biodiversity verification, and ESG compliance.

Planet One Explorer (`https://explorer.planetone.io`) is the primary interface for inspecting blocks, transactions, smart contracts, decentralized accounts, validator nodes, and on-chain environmental assets.

## Core Network Specifications

- **Network Name**: Planet One Mainnet
- **Native Utility Coin**: PLO (1 PLO = 10^8 atomic units)
- **Testnet Coin**: PLOT (1 PLOT = 10^8 atomic units)
- **Flagship Environmental Asset**: VERDE (Tokenized Certified Carbon & Forest Reserves)
- **Consensus Algorithm**: Fair Proof-of-Stake (FPoS) with Waves-NG microblocks
- **Block Time**: ~60 seconds (with sub-second microblock confirmations)
- **Chain ID**: 80 (Character: 'P')
- **Testnet Chain ID**: 83 (Character: 'S')
- **Address Encodings**: Native Base58 (starts with 3P...) and EVM Equivalence (0x...)
- **Smart Contract Engine**: Ride (Functional, deterministic, formal verification) + EVM Transaction (Type 18) support

## Key Web Pages & Explorer Sections

- [Home Dashboard](https://explorer.planetone.io/): Real-time network telemetry, block height, transactions/s, consensus voting, and live feed.
- [Blocks Explorer](https://explorer.planetone.io/blocks): Chronological ledger of all blocks, generator validators, sizes, fees, and signatures.
- [Transactions Stream](https://explorer.planetone.io/transactions): Comprehensive transaction stream with filters for transfers, dApp invocations, asset creation, and EVM executions.
- [Smart Contracts & dApps](https://explorer.planetone.io/contracts): Directory of audited on-chain smart contracts with callable function interfaces and Ride bytecode inspection.
- [Network & Validator Nodes](https://explorer.planetone.io/nodes): Global telemetry of active peers, block producers, protocol features, and consensus health.
- [Rich List & Balances Ranking](https://explorer.planetone.io/ranking): On-chain ranking of top token and asset holders.
- [3D Carbon Map](https://explorer.planetone.io/carbon-map): Interactive geospatial and 3D terrain visualization of tokenized preservation areas and carbon sink polygons.
- [Address & Hash Converter](https://explorer.planetone.io/address-converter): Bidirectional converter between Base58 and EVM (0x MetaMask) representations.
- [Testnet Faucet](https://explorer.planetone.io/faucet): Automated faucet providing testnet PLOT for developers and test suites.
- [VERDE Environmental Asset Portal](https://explorer.planetone.io/tokenplanet/VERDE): Environmental verification metrics, preserved hectares, CO2 tons retired, and asset backing.

## Real-Time Node & FullExplorer Endpoints

- **Public Node RPC**: `https://nodes.planetone.io`
- **EVM RPC Endpoint**: `https://rpc.planetone.io` (Chain ID 80)
- **FullExplorer UI**: `https://fullexplorer.planetone.io`
- **FullExplorer API**: `https://fullexplorer.planetone.io/api`
- **Testnet Node RPC**: `https://nodes-testnet.planetone.io`
- **Testnet EVM RPC**: `https://rpc-testnet.planetone.io`

## Sitemaps & Feeds

- [Sitemap Index](https://explorer.planetone.io/sitemap.xml): Index of all blockchain objects (blocks, transactions, addresses, tokens).
- [Main Pages Sitemap](https://explorer.planetone.io/sitemap-main.xml): Core explorer routes.
- [Blocks Sitemap](https://explorer.planetone.io/sitemap-blocks.xml): Indexed block heights.
- [Transactions Sitemap](https://explorer.planetone.io/sitemap-transactions.xml): Indexed transaction IDs.
- [Addresses Sitemap](https://explorer.planetone.io/sitemap-addresses.xml): Indexed accounts and contracts.
- [Assets Sitemap](https://explorer.planetone.io/sitemap-assets.xml): Native and tokenized assets.
